The vendor directly providing **jQuery** at **jquery.com** is the **OpenJS Foundation** (in conjunction with the jQuery contributor community).

### Evidence
* **Copyright and Legal Terms:** The official site footer across `jquery.com` states:  
  > *"Copyright ... OpenJS Foundation and jQuery contributors. All rights reserved. See jQuery License for more information. ... OpenJS Foundation Terms of Use, Privacy, Code of Conduct, and Cookie Policies also apply."*
* **License & Project Governance:** The `jquery.com/license/` documentation notes that:  
  > *"the term 'Project' will refer to any OpenJS Foundation project using the MIT license AND referencing this document in the header of the distributed Project code or Project website source code."*
